name: ntfy Push
description: Reference HTTP Bridge channel plugin delivering RSS articles as push notifications to ntfy.sh or self-hosted ntfy servers with topic, priority, tags, and bearer token auth.
compose_snippet:
services:
  feedcourier-ntfy:
    build: ./channels/ntfy
    environment:
      BRIDGE_SECRET: "replace-with-strong-secret"
      PORT: "8787"
    restart: unless-stopped
